1.1: Haroe reiyya achat shel zov, bet shammay omrim, keshomeret yom keneged yom. uvet hillel omrim, kevaal keri. raa achat, uvashsheni hifsik, uvashshelishi raa shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, bet shammay omrim, zav gamur. uvet hillel omrim, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban. amar rabbi eliezer ben yehuda, modim bet shammay baze sheeno zav gamur. veal ma nechleku, al haroe shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, uvashsheni hifsik, uvashshelishi raa achat, bet shammay omrim, zav gamur. uvet hillel omrim, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban:
1.2: Haroe keri bayyom hashshelishi lisfirat zovo, bet shammay omrim, soter shene yamim shellefanav. uvet hillel omrim, lo satar ella yomo. rabbi yishmael omer, haroe vashsheni, soter et shellefanav. rabbi akiva omer, echad haroe vashsheni veechad haroe vashshelishi, shebbet shammay omrim, satar shene yamim shellefanav. uvet hillel omrim, lo satar ella yomo. umodim beroe varvii shello satar ella yomo, beraa keri. aval im raa zov, afillu yom shevii, satar et shellefanav:
1.3: Raa achat hayyom ushetayim lemachar, shetayim hayyom veachat lemachar, shalosh lishlosha yamim o lishlosha lelot, hare ze zav gamur:
1.4: Raa achat vehifsik kede tevila vesippug, veachar kach raa shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, o raa shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, vehifsik kede tevila vesippug, veachar kach raa achat, hare ze zav gamur:
1.5: Raa achat merubba cheshalosh, shehi chemin gad yon lashshiloach, shehen kede shete tevilot vechishne sippugin, hare ze zav gamur. raa achat merubba chishtayim, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban. amar rabbi yose, lo amru achat merubba ella im ken yesh bah kede shalosh:
1.6: Raa achat hayyom veachat ben hashshemashot, achat ben hashshemashot veachat lemachar, im yadua shemmiktzat hariyya mehayyom umiktzatah lemachar, vadday lakkarban velattuma. im safek shemmiktzat hariyya mehayyom umiktzatah lemachar, vadday lattuma vesafek lakkarban. raa shene yamim ben hashshemashot, safek lattuma velakkarban. achat ben hashshemashot, safek lattuma:

2.1: Hakkol mittammein beziva, af haggerim, af haavadim, ben meshuchrarin ben sheenan meshuchrarin, cheresh, shote, vekatan, seris adam, seris chamma. tumtum veanderoginos, notnin alehen chumre haish vechumre haishsha, mittammein bedam kaishsha uveloven kaish, vetumatan besafek:
2.2: Beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav ad shello nizkak leziva. bemaachol, bemishte, uvemassa, bikfitza, becholi, uvemare uvehirhur. hirher ad shello raa o sheraa ad shello hirher. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu raa vehema, chayya vaof mitassekin ze im ze, afillu raa vigde tzeva haishsha. rabbi akiva omer, afillu achal kol maachol, ben ra ben yafe, veshata chol mashke. amru lo, en kan zavin meatta. amar lahem, en acharayut zavim alechem. mishshennizkak leziva, en bodkin oto. anso usefeko veshichvat zaro temeim, sheraglayim laddavar. raa reiyya rishona, bodkin oto. bashsheniyya, bodkin oto. bashshelishit, en bodkin oto. rabbi eliezer omer, af bashshelishit bodkin oto, mippene hakkarban:
2.3: Haroe keri, eno mittamme veziva meet leet. rabbi yose omer, yomo. nachri sheraa keri venitgayyer, miyyad hu mittamme veziva. haroa dam vehammaksha, meet leet. vehammakke et avdo yom yomayim, meet leet. kelev sheachal besar hammet, shelosha yamim meet leet, hare hu chivriyyato:
2.4: Hazzav metamme et hammishkav bachamishsha derachim, letamme adam letamme vegadim. omed, yoshev, shochev, nitle venishan. vehammishkav metamme et haadam beshiva derachim letamme vegadim. omed, yoshev, shochev, nitle, venishan, bemagga uvemassa:

3.1: Hazzav vehattahor sheyyashvu visfina o veasda o sherachvu al gabbe vehema, af al pi sheen bigdehem nogim, hare ellu temeim midras. yashvu al hanneser, al hassafsal, al haggashish shel mitta veal haachlonas, bizman shehen machgirin, alu veilan shekkocho ra, besocha shekkochah ra, beilan yafe, besullam mitzri bizman sheeno kavua bemasmer, al hakkevesh veal hakkora veal haddelet bizman sheen asuyin betit, temeim. rabbi yehuda metaher:
3.2: Megifin o fotchin. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyehe ze megif veze foteach. maalin ze et ze min habbor. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyehe hattahor maale et hattame. mafshilin bachavalin. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyihye ze moshech helech veze moshech helech. orgim, ben beomdin ben beyoshvin o tochanin. rabbi shimon metaher bechullan, chutz min hattochanin berechayim shel yad. porkin min hachamor o toanin, bizman shemmassaam kaved, temein. bizman shemmasaam kal, tehorin. vechullan tehorin livne hakkeneset utemein latteruma:
3.3: Hazzav vehattahor sheyyashvu visfina gedola, ezo hi sefina gedola. rabbi yehuda omer, kol sheenah yechola lehamit baadam. yashvu al hanneser, al hassafsal, al haggashish shel mitta veal haachlonas bizman sheenan machgirin, alu veilan shekkocho yafe, besocha shekkochah yafe, uvesullam tzori o mitzri bizman shehu kavua bemasmer, al hakkevesh, al hakkora veal haddelet bizman shehen asuyin betit afillu mitztzad echad, tehorin. hattahor makke et hattame, tahor. hattame makke et hattahor, tame, sheim yimmashech hattahor, hare hattame nofel:

4.1: Rabbi yehoshua omer, nidda sheyyashva im hattehora bemitta, kippa shebberoshah tame midras. yashva visfina, kelim shebberosh hannes shebbassefina temein midras. notelet areva melea vegadim, bizman shemmassaan kaved, temein. bizman shemmassaan kal, tehorin. zav shehikkish al ketzotzra, venafal kikkar shel teruma, tahor:
4.2: Hikkish al hammarish, al hammalben, al hatztzinnor, veal haddaf, af al pi shehu asuy bachavalim, al hattannur, veal hayyam, veal itzterubbal, veal chamor shel rechayim shel yad, veal sea shel rechayim shel zetim, rabbi yose omer, af al korat habballanin, tahor:
4.3: Hikkish al haddelet, al hanneger, al hammanul, al hammashot, veal hakkelet, veal ilan shekkocho ra, veal socha shekkochah ra, al ilan yafe, al sullam mitzri bizman sheeno kavua bemasmer, al hakkevesh, al hakkora veal haddelet bizman sheenan asuyin betit, temein. al hashshidda, al hatteva veal hammigdal, temein. rabbi nechemya verabbi shimon metaharin baellu:
4.4: Zav shehaya muttal al chamishsha safsalim o al chamesh pundiyyot, learkan, temein. lerachban, tehorin. yashen, safek shennithappech alehen, temein. haya muttal al shishsha chisyot, shete yadav al shenayim, shete raglav al shenayim, rosho al echad, gufo al echad, en tame ella ze shettachat hagguf. omed al shene chisot, rabbi shimon omer, im rechokin ze mizze, tehorin:
4.5: Eser talliyyot zo al gav zo, yashen al gabbe haelyona, kullan temeot. hazzav bechaf moznayim umishkav umoshav kenegdo, kara hazzav, tehorin. karu hen, temein. rabbi shimon omer, bichidi, tame. uvimrubbin, tahor, sheen echad nose et rubbo:
4.6: Hazzav bechaf moznayim veochalin umashkin bechaf sheniyya, temein. uvammet, hakkol tahor, chutz min haadam. ze chomer bazzav mibbammet. chomer bammet mibbazzav, shehazzav ose mishkav umoshav mittachtav letamme adam uletamme vegadim, veal gabbav maddaf letamme ochalin umashkin, ma sheen hammet metamme. chomer bammet, shehammet metamme veohel umetamme tumat shiva, ma sheen hazzav metamme:
4.7: Haya yoshev al gabbe hammitta vearba talliyyot tachat arba ragle hammitta, temeot, mippene sheenah yechola laamod al shalosh. rabbi shimon metaher. haya rochev al gabbe vehema vearba talliyyot tachat arba ragle vehema, tehorot, mippene shehi yechola laamod al shelosha. hayta tallit achat tachat shene yadayim, tachat shene raglayim, tachat yad varegel, temea. rabbi yose omer, hassus metamme veraglav vehachamor beyadav, shemmishenet hassus al raglav umishenet hachamor al yadav. yashav al korat bet habbad, kelim shebbaekel temein. al hammachbesh shel koves, kelim shettachtav, tehorin. rabbi nechemya metamme:

5.1: Hannogea bazzav o shehazzav noge bo, hammassit et hazzav o shehazzav massito, metamme ochalim umashkim uchele shetef bemagga, aval lo vemassa. kelal amar rabbi yehoshua, kol hametamme vegadim bishat maggao, metamme ochalim umashkin lihyot techilla, vehayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot, veeno metamme lo adam velo chele cheres. leachar perishato mimmetammeav, metamme mashkin lihyot techilla, vehoochalin vehayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot, veeno metamme vegadim:
5.2: Veod kelal acher amru. kol hannissa al gabbe hazzav, tame. vechol shehazzav nissa alav, tahor, chutz min harauy lemishkav ulemoshav vehaadam. ketzad. etzbao shel zav tachat hannidbach, hattahor milmalan, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad. hattame milmalan vehattahor millemattan, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metame echad ufosel echad. hoochalin vehammashkin, hammishkav, vehammoshav vehammaddaf milmalan, metammein shenayim ufoslin echad. pershu, metammein echad ufoslin echad. vehammishkav vehammoshav millemattan, metammein shenayim ufoslin echad. pershu, metammein shenayim ufoslin echad. hoochalin vehammashkin vehammaddaf millemattan, tehorin:
5.3: Mippene sheamru, kol hannose venissa al gabbe mishkav, tahor, chutz min haadam. kol hannose venissa al gabbe hannevela, tahor, chutz min hammassit. rabbi eliezer omer, af hannose. kol hannose venissa al gabbe hammet, tahor, chutz min hammaahil, veadam bizman shehu massit:
5.4: Miktzat tame al hattahor umiktzat tahor al hattame, chibbure tame al hattahor vechibbure tahor al hattame, tame. rabbi shimon omer, miktzat tame al hattahor, tame. umiktzat tahor al hattame, tahor:
5.5: Hattame al miktzat hammishkav vehattahor al miktzat hammishkav, tame. miktzat tame al hammishkav umiktzat tahor al hammishkav, tahor. nimtzet tuma nichneset lo veyotzet mimmennu bemiuto. vechen kikkar shel teruma shehu natun al gabbe mishkav vehanneyar bentayim, ben milmalan ben millemattan, tahor. vechen beeven hamenuggaat, tahor. rabbi shimon metamme vazo:
5.6: Hannogea bezav, uvezava, uvenidda, uveyoledet, uvimtzora, bemishkav, umoshav, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad, echad hannogea veechad hammassit veechad hannose veechad hannissa:
5.7: Hannogea bezovo shel zav, uverukko, beshichvat zaro, bememe raglav, uvedam hannidda, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad, echad hannogea veechad hammassit. rabbi eliezer omer, af hannose:
5.8: Hannose et hammerkav vehannissa alav vehammassito, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad. hannose et hannevela, veet me chattat sheyyesh bahem kede hazzaya, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad:
5.9: Haochel minnivlat of tahor vehi bevet habbelia, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. hichnis rosho laavir hattannur, tahor, vetahor hattannur. hekiah o velaah, metamme echad ufosel echad. ucheshehi vetoch piv, ad sheyyivlaenna, tahor:
5.10: Hannogea besheretz uveshichvat zera, uvitme met, uvimtzora bime safro, uveme chattat sheen bahem kede hazzaya, uvinvela, uvemerkav, metamme echad ufosel echad. ze hakkelal, kol hannogea beachad mikkol avot hattumot shebbattora, metamme echad ufosel echad, chutz min haadam. perash, metamme echad ufosel echad:
5.11: Baal keri, kemagga sheretz. uvoel nidda, kitme met, ella shechamur mimmennu boel nidda, shehu metamme mishkav umoshav tuma kalla letamme ochalin umashkin:
5.12: Ellu foslim et hatteruma. haochel ochel rishon, vehaochel ochel sheni, vehashshote mashkin temein, vehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin, vetahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, vehassefer, vehayyadayim, utevul yom, vehoochalim vehakkelim shennitmeu vemashkim:
